m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: You seek the Council? Oh, they're in closed session. But judging by the look of you, I'd bet they'll see you. Go in the Inner Chamber, there.
Bat, Child of Spider, has come to Athanor and is working to destroy us? Ancient legends warn of a time Spider would try to break the Chain.
If that Chain breaks the Chaos Heart will be at risk. It may already be too late!
The letter says there was sabotage up on the glacier - a shaft to the Core was undermining the Ice Cap.
The Core? Oh, it had to be the Fire Dwarves! Those hot-headed fools always hated us, and now they're trying to wipe us out, you betcha! I say we shut down the Pumps!
We and our Fire Dwarf cousins in the Core work tirelessly to keep Athanor in balance.
We pump water into the Core to keep Lava Elementals from rising. The Fire Dwarves vent steam to us to keep the Ice Creatures under control.
If we turn off the Pumps the Fire Dwarves burn. If they turn off the Steam Vents, we freeze.
You must not turn off those Pumps - escalation will only cause more chaos - that's what the Bat wants!
Something terrible is happening at the Melting Station!
They say ancient spells hold this glacier together, dontcha know. Heat from the Core'll wear them out, and then the whole ice cap could go!
If there was one piece of sabotage, there might be more. The Supreme Council needs to know about this, right away! I'm too busy up here - you go an' tell 'em.
I'll come with you, Wizard - Beans and Sparck will take care of the wounded and the Streamportal.
You'll want to take this letter here to the Council. It'll vouch for you, okay? Now get going, double quick!
The Supreme Council needs to know about the sabotage you found. So go tell 'em, already!
